headline: Major Gold ETFs fall up to 2.3% on Dhanteras
hook: Gold ETFs dip on auspicious Dhanteras day
summary: Major Indian Gold ETFs including Nippon India, Tata, and ICICI Prudential saw a decline of up to 2.3% during the Dhanteras trading session. This price correction occurred despite the traditional surge in gold demand during the festive period. The drop in ETF values directly tracks the movement of underlying physical gold prices in the domestic market. Retail investors who purchased gold digitally today benefited from lower prices compared to previous sessions.
whats_next: Global gold price trends and US Fed commentary
why_it_matters: Lower entry prices for gold buyers this festive season
winners_losers: New buyers gain / existing holders hurt
